novel_features.name: No API Key Required
novel_features.description: Fetches live Google Maps reviews by reverse-engineering the internal listentitiesreviews endpoint — no Google API key or OAuth needed. Authenticates via Chrome's NID cookie read automatically by agent-browser.

novel_features.name: CID Auto-Parse
novel_features.description: Accepts full Google Maps URLs or raw 0xHEX:0xHEX CID strings, extracting the two uint64 values and encoding them into the Maps protobuf pb= parameter automatically.

novel_features.name: Rating Distribution Summary
novel_features.description: Returns the full star-distribution breakdown (1-5 stars) and total review count for any business — data not available via the official Places API.

novel_features.name: Auto-Paginate All Reviews
novel_features.description: Paginates through all available reviews (up to ~300, Google's internal API limit) with graceful degradation — stops cleanly if the API returns 500 on later pages.
